title: Menagerie crawler durable text-corpus index v1

corpus_row_id.description: Deterministic row identity: the stable hash of the type tag plus stable_id, content_sha256, source_id, role, and origin. Two hosts promoting the same document for the same model mint the same row, so cross-host replays stay idempotent and a conflicting replay is refused by the ledger.

stable_id.description: Durable identifier of the model whose crawl retained this document.

work_id.description: Work identity recorded by the author custody envelope, empty when the source envelope predates work identity.

source_id.description: Per-model source identifier from the broker pack or the reserved discovery identifier. Excerpt evidence binds to documents through this id plus the manifest digest, so excerpt-to-document resolution never needs the scratch tree.

role.description: Closed retained-role vocabulary. The three broker manifest roles are kept verbatim; probe covers fetched-but-unmanifested candidate bytes, discovery the frozen discovery envelope, machine-inventory the routed-environment inventory document, and uncatalogued a CAS object present in custody with no surviving manifest or outcome row to classify it.

requested_role.description: The author's requested role for this source, when an outcome row recorded one. Advisory provenance only; role is the machine-bound authority.

origin.description: Closed vocabulary naming which retention class produced the bytes: a custody-manifest promotion, a fetched broker evidence blob with no manifest row, the frozen discovery envelope, or a source-cas object swept without an outcome row.

content_sha256.description: Exact digest of the stored payload bytes. The payload lives at the two-level content address under the corpus root and is re-hashed on every read; this field is the join key for excerpt resolution and cross-shard union.

bytes_len.description: Exact payload byte length, recomputed from the admitted bytes rather than copied from any producer field.

media_type.description: Media type recorded by the broker outcome, or application/octet-stream when no outcome row survives.

url.description: Locator the bytes were fetched from, or the urn the discovery envelope was frozen under. Empty only for swept CAS objects with no surviving outcome row.

final_url.description: Post-redirect locator when the outcome row recorded one.

forge.description: Forge host that answered the resolver receipt (for example ``github.com``); the document's provenance authority, not a fetch URL.

repo.description: Repository the document was resolved from, as the resolver receipt recorded it.

ref.description: Ref the author requested (tag, branch, or commit) before resolution.

resolved_sha.description: Exact commit the forge resolved that ref to, so a later reader can re-fetch the identical bytes.

locator.description: Resolver-receipt subset for forge-file sources: enough to re-derive the exact upstream revision without the scratch tree.

retrieved_at.description: Broker-clock instant the exact bytes finished fetching, carried verbatim from the outcome row; empty when the retention class has no fetch instant (a frozen discovery envelope, a swept CAS object). Never minted at promotion time, so replays are byte-identical.

license_disposition.description: Redistribution class mirrored from the artifact-authority license decision when one covers this digest, else the conservative manifest-only default. Advisory metadata for corpus consumers; it grants no publication authority of its own -- the artifact ledger remains the only authority.

custody_disposition.description: The source-custody disposition observed for this document when the row originates from a custody promotion.

ledger_seq.description: Local append sequence stamped by the ledger.

payload_sha256.description: Row self-digest stamped by the ledger.

shadow_rehearsal.description: Optional W3 shadow-rehearsal marker: the declared rehearsal generation namespace stamped by the write-side producer while MENAGERIE_SHADOW_REHEARSAL_RUN is set. Presence excludes the record from every reuse/authority seam (W44); it grants nothing.
